There is no heading: the first item starts 80px below the section top and the last ends 80px above the bottom. The list reuses the hero title's exact type size, so it reads as another poster.
mobile: Items at 15vw, one per line, flush left with 16px margins. Each detail moves beneath its item at 15px, left-aligned, with 6px above and 22px below. If any single word is wider than the screen at 15vw, drop the whole list to 12vw rather than breaking a word.

name: Sticky photograph, active list
blueprint: Two columns. The left, columns 1–5, is `position: sticky; top: 12vh` and holds one photograph or object at 4:5, 34vw wide, unframed on the ground. The right, columns 7–11, holds a vertical list of five to nine names (treatments, rooms, courses, services) at clamp(20px, 1.6vw, 24px), each row 58px tall with the name at the left and a price or duration right-aligned at 15px in the soft ink. The active row is full ink; the others rest at 40% opacity. Hovering, focusing or scrolling a row to the middle of the viewport makes it active, crossfades the left photograph to that item's image over 300ms, and opens a three-line description at 15px, 34ch wide, directly under the name, pushing later rows down. A heading of two or three words at clamp(32px, 3.4vw, 48px) sits above the list, aligned to its left edge, 48px above the first row.
mobile: The photograph becomes a 4:3 band pinned to the top of the screen at 38svh while the list scrolls beneath it; the heading sits above the first row. Rows are 56px tall and the description opens on tap. The image changes with the row nearest the band.

name: Two-ended rows, narrow column
blueprint: A list in one narrow column, 520px wide, starting at 22% of the viewport width or centred. Every row is 34–38px tall with no box and nothing drawn between rows. Each row has two ends: at the left, a 16px round image (a face, a logo, a colour dot) followed after 8px by the name at 15–16px in full ink; at the far right of the column, a short value at 13px in the soft ink (a date, a price, a domain, an opening time) with tabular figures. Entries that need a sentence run to two lines at the left, and the value aligns with the first line. Groups are separated by 40px of space and begin with one plain word in the soft ink at the same size. A heading of two to four words at 24–28px in medium weight sits 32px above the first row. Holds 10–40 rows.
mobile: The column fills the width with 20px margins. Rows are 44px tall for touch; the left image stays 16px. Long values wrap beneath the name at 13px, left-aligned with it, and the row grows. Group spacing is 32px.

name: The printed menu sheet
blueprint: The list is one tall sheet of paper. A filled paper-colour panel 640px wide sits centred, or offset to columns 7–12, on a contrasting flat ground or a full-bleed photograph, with square corners and its top and bottom edges cut into shallow scallops by `clip-path` or an SVG `mask`. Inside, 64px padding and a centred, symmetrical setting like a printed card: the venue or section name at 40–48px, a one-line note at 15px, then three or four groups 56px apart. Each group opens with its name at 22px, centred. Items follow at 17px with 16px between them: the dish or service at the left of a 420px measure, the price at the right with tabular figures, and a one-line description at 14px in the soft ink under the name. Alignment alone links name and price; there are no leaders. The sheet ends with the opening hours as two centred lines. Holds 12–24 items.
mobile: The sheet spans the screen with 10px of ground showing at each side and 28px padding; the scalloped edges stay at top and bottom. The measure is the full inner width and prices stay right-aligned. Group names at 20px, items at 16px.
bannedWhy: A paper panel with scalloped edges on a contrasting ground: a fourth surface (round 4, r4-p25).

name: Statement, table beside its picture
blueprint: A heading of four to six words on two lines, flush to the left margin across the full width. 64–96px below, two parts, top-aligned: in columns 1–5, one 4:5 photograph of what the table lists (the room the rates are for, the office, the hall), from the left margin; in columns 6–12, the table. Without such a photograph the table takes the full width instead, its three parts spread across columns 1–12, so no row is empty on its left. Each row is a three-part line at the body size with 26px between rows: the kind or day at the left of the measure, the place or service at 40%, and the address, time or price right-aligned, with a small arrow where the row links. Rows are separated by space only; every fourth row has 44px above it to form groups. The heading names the table: no label beside it. Holds 5–14 rows.
mobile: Heading at the phone display size, flush left. The photograph first at full width (4:5), then the table at full width: each row stacks the kind above the place, with the value right-aligned on the first line.

name: Address in display rows
blueprint: The contact block is a stack of five full-width rows, every one set at the same size, clamp(44px, 6vw, 88px), regular weight, left-aligned with a 20px inset and leading 1.0: the building or venue name, the street, the city with postcode, the opening hours as one compact line, the phone number. Each row is about 150px tall with the text sitting in its lower third; rows are told apart by alternating two flat tones of the section colour as full-width bands, or by 28px of space alone. A sixth row holds a one-word greeting at the same size followed, 24px to its right and centred on the x-height, by a solid round button 0.9em across with an arrow, which opens the email or booking link. Street and phone rows are links (map, call). No heading and no form. Optionally, one small round photograph sits at the right end of the first row.
mobile: Rows at 9.6vw with 16px insets, about 84px tall; the hours break onto two rows (days, then times). The greeting row becomes a full-width band in the accent colour with the round arrow button at its right end, 56px across.

name: The email as display type
blueprint: The section is 100svh in the inverse of the page's colours. A single email address is set as one line of display type spanning the content width: the font-size is fitted so the address runs from margin to margin (about 7–9vw for 20 characters; break after the @ onto two lines if it is longer than 26), light or regular weight, tight tracking, sitting on a baseline 12vh above the bottom edge. It is a `mailto:` link; on hover the whole line takes the accent ink. In the top-left corner, a sentence of up to 12 words at 20–22px says what to write about. In the two bottom corners at 14px: phone and city at the left, two or three social links at the right. No heading and no form. For a pinned ending, make the section `position: sticky; bottom: 0` beneath the page so the previous section lifts off it.
mobile: The address breaks after the @ onto two lines at 11.5vw, left-aligned, sitting at 55% of an 86svh screen. The sentence sits at the top-left at 18px. Phone, city and social links stack at the bottom-left at 15px with 12px between them.
bannedWhy: The email set at 7-9vw across the width (round 4, r4-p22).

name: Photo strip, three-cell bar
blueprint: A saturated flat field about 80svh tall. Across the top, 48px from the section edge, a strip of small photographs runs off both sides: all 150px tall at differing widths (3:4, 1:1, 3:2 in turn), 8px gaps, ten or more, drifting slowly as a marquee. A heading of two to four words at clamp(36px, 4vw, 60px) sits 72px below the strip at the left margin. 40px below the heading, the newsletter or booking form is one bar spanning the content width, 96px tall, divided into three equal cells with 8px gaps. Each cell is a filled block in a tone one step from the field with one radius: the first two are inputs (name, email) with placeholder text centred at 18px, the third is the submit action in the inverse colours with its word centred. Focus changes a cell's fill to the lightest tone. Small print at 13px sits under the first and third cells.
mobile: The strip is 110px tall and scrolls by touch. The heading follows at 9vw. The three cells stack as full-width filled blocks 60px tall with 8px gaps, the submit block last. Small print sits beneath the stack, left-aligned.

name: Clip-out coupon form
blueprint: The form is a coupon to cut out. One filled card in a strong flat colour, about 2.2:1, spans columns 2–11 with a 14px radius, with 120px of ground above and below. Semicircular notches 28px across are cut into its top and bottom edges at the 46% mark with `clip-path` or an SVG `mask`, and a vertical row of round dots (a dotted `border-left` 5px thick in the ground colour) joins the two notches as the perforation. Left of the perforation, with 48px padding: a two-line heading of three to five words at clamp(28px, 3vw, 44px) in heavy capitals at the top, and one sentence at 16px at the bottom. Right of it: four inputs stacked with 10px gaps, each a filled block 52px tall in a lighter tone of the card with its placeholder at 16px, then a full-width solid submit bar 56px tall in the darkest ink. Inputs keep visually hidden `label` elements.
mobile: The card turns upright and spans the width with 12px margins. The perforation becomes horizontal: notches on the left and right edges, dots across. Heading and sentence sit above it; the four inputs and the submit bar sit below, each 54px tall.
bannedWhy: A coupon cut to a shape by clip-path or a mask, with a dotted perforation: framed-elements fails it (r9-p43, round 11).

name: One field, nothing else
blueprint: The whole section is one prompt and one field in a column 520px wide, on the page's text column line or centred, with 200px of empty ground above and 160px below. The prompt is two lines at one size, 24–28px in medium weight: the first line in the soft ink, the second in full ink. 28px below, a single input 520px wide and 64px tall with a 12px radius, filled with the lightest tone on the page so it is the only bright surface in view; no outline at rest and a 2px inner ring in the accent on focus. Inside the right end of the field, 8px from its edge, a round submit button 44px across with an arrow and an accessible name. 16px below the field, one line at 13px says what happens next. 72px lower, three label and value rows at 14px: email, phone, address.
mobile: The column fills the width with 20px margins. Prompt at 22px. The field stays one row, 60px tall, with the arrow button inside its right end. The three label and value rows stack with the label above each value and 20px between them.

name: Visit card beside a photograph
blueprint: A photograph of the place on columns 1–7, inside the page margins, as tall as the section (about 80svh), with the dealt corner and `object-fit: cover`, its focal point in the middle. On columns 8–12, on the page ground and top-aligned with the photograph, one filled card in the card style section 0 deals: a two- or three-word title at the h3 step; the street and the district on two lines at body size; the opening hours as three rows with the days at the left and the times right-aligned in tabular figures; the email (a phone only where the brief gives one); then a Directions link and, at the card's foot, the booking button where the page books. Nothing is laid over the photograph, and there is no heading outside the card.
mobile: The photograph comes first at the full content width at 4:5, inside the page margins; the card follows 24px under it at full width, its button full width at its foot, 52px tall.

name: Sentence, portrait, two links
blueprint: One closing row of three elements hanging from the same top line, with open ground between them, on a 12-column grid. Columns 1–5: a sentence of 10–14 words at clamp(24px, 2.5vw, 36px), three lines at most, leading 1.15, saying what kind of enquiries are welcome; it is set as a paragraph and there is no separate heading. Columns 8–9: one small square portrait or photograph of the place, 150–170px, with square corners. Columns 10–12: a short question at 18px in medium weight, then 20px below it two underlined links stacked at 18px (the email address and one booking or social link), and beneath them a line at 14px in the soft ink with the city and the usual reply time. Columns 6–7 stay empty. The row has 160px of space above and 120px below. No form. On a dark ground the photograph is the only bright thing in the row.
mobile: The sentence comes first at 6vw, four lines at most. Below it the portrait at 96px square sits at the left margin with the question and the two links to its right, top-aligned, in the remaining width. The city and reply-time line spans the full width beneath.

name: One control, blown up
blueprint: A flat saturated field, full-bleed and 92svh tall, holds one working control from the product: the toggle, slider, segmented switch or record button the whole product turns on. Build it at true proportions with every dimension in em, mark its root data-ui, then raise that root's font-size until the control stands about 46vh tall. Anchor it right of centre, its right side on the right margin, so the section's bottom edge crops about a fifth of it (overflow: hidden on the section). It keeps its real label and value, now at poster size, and it works: operating it swaps the field between two palette colours and changes one word of the heading. The heading, two to four words at clamp(28px, 2.6vw, 40px), sits top-left on the page margin with one sentence at 17px beneath it. The lower-left third of the field stays empty.
mobile: The field is 86svh. Heading and sentence sit top-left at 26px and 16px. The control is enlarged to the full content width between the page margins and anchored at the bottom, so the section's lower edge crops its foot while its thumb or active segment stays within reach. It still works and still swaps the field colour.

name: Output index, live sheet
blueprint: For products that make documents: invoices, reports, emails, statements. Columns 1–5 list the names of three to five outputs, one per line, at clamp(36px, 4vw, 64px), leading 1.1, each a `<button>`; the selected name is in full ink, the rest in the soft ink. There is no other heading. Columns 7–12 are a stage in a flat tone one step from the ground, 88svh tall, and on it lies the selected output as an object: a paper-white sheet 560px wide, built in HTML at true size, root marked data-ui, with a real sender, real line items, sums that add up and a date. The sheet starts 72px below the stage's top and runs past its bottom edge, which crops it. Selecting a name swaps the sheet with a 200ms crossfade; an email is narrower (440px), a receipt narrower still (300px), all left-aligned 64px into the stage.
mobile: Names become one sideways-scrolling row at 22px with scroll-snap, the selected one in full ink. Beneath, the stage fills the content width inside the page margins and is 70svh tall; the sheet keeps its true size, anchored top-left with a 16px inset, and the stage crops its right and bottom edges inside the margins. Tapping a name swaps it.

name: One row, three states
blueprint: The product's central row (a task, a transaction, a message, a deploy) is shown three times, one directly beneath the other, in three states: as it arrives, with the pointer on it and its actions revealed, and finished. Each copy is built at true size, 640px wide, with real names, amounts and times, its root marked data-ui; inside it the product's own control borders and radii apply. The copies sit in columns 4–9 with 56px between them and nothing framing them. In columns 1–3, right-aligned and level with each copy, one word at 22px in the soft ink names its state. Columns 10–12 stay empty. The middle copy is live: its checkbox or button works and turns it into the third state. The heading, two to four words at 28–32px, sits on column 4's left edge, 96px above the first copy, with no supporting line.
mobile: Copies stack at full width with 16px margins and stay at true size; a row wider than the screen is cropped at its right end, never shrunk. Each state word sits beneath its copy at 17px in the soft ink, 10px away. 48px separates the three groups. Heading at 26px.

name: Headline you can type
blueprint: The section's headline is an input. One line at clamp(48px, 8vw, 132px), tight tracking, flush left across columns 1–12, is a real `<input>` (root marked data-ui) with no border and no fill, prefilled with a believable two-to-five-word example of what a user gives the product: a search, a question, a date in words, a colour name. A solid caret block 0.08em wide blinks after the last character. 48px beneath, on the same left edge, the product's answer appears at true interface size, at most 560px wide: three result rows, one parsed value, or a swatch, updating as the visitor types. Bottom-left, three more examples at 17px act as plain text buttons that refill the line. The rest of the 88svh field is empty. If the text outgrows the line it scrolls inside the input; it never wraps.
mobile: The input is set at 11vw on one line and scrolls sideways inside itself when the text runs long. The answer follows 28px below at full width and true size. The three examples become a wrapping row of filled blocks 44px tall beneath the answer; tapping one refills the line.

name: Input half, output half
blueprint: Two flat fields meet on a vertical edge at 50vw, each 90svh tall, no gap. The left field is the darkest palette tone and holds what the user hands the product, raw: a pasted note, a messy row of figures, a prompt, or literal code inside `<code>`. It is an editable region at 20–24px, 34ch wide, starting at column 2, 30% down the field. The right field is the lightest tone and holds what the product makes of it as a true-size fragment marked data-ui: the tidy record, the chart, the formatted reply, 440–520px wide, on the same top line. Editing the left changes the right. The heading is split across the edge: its first one or two words bottom-left on the dark field, its last one or two bottom-right on the light field, both at clamp(40px, 5vw, 80px) on one baseline 32px from the bottom.
mobile: The fields stack, dark above light, each 62svh, meeting on a horizontal edge. Input text at 18px with 20px margins; the output fragment at true size on the light field. The heading's two parts sit either side of that edge at 11vw: one at the foot of the dark field, one at the top of the light.

name: Rows as a board
blueprint: The product's main list is set like a station departure board. Eight to ten real rows (transactions, issues, deploys, bookings) run the full viewport width inside 12px side margins. Each row is a filled band 72px tall, one tone off a dark ground, separated from the next by a 4px gap and never by a line; the whole board is one fragment marked data-ui. Text inside is 26–30px: the name from column 1, two or three facts at columns 6, 8 and 10, and at column 12 a status word on a solid block of its status colour; figures use tabular numerals. The section's top and bottom edges cut the first and last rows in half, so the list seems to continue. The fourth row is open: 216px tall, in the accent colour, with its detail in two lines at 17px. Clicking another row opens that one instead. No heading: the open row's name is the largest type.
mobile: Rows keep the 4px gaps and are 64px tall inside 8px margins: the name at 20px on the left, the status block on the right, the other facts dropped. The open row is 200px tall and lists the dropped facts as three lines at 16px. Six rows show; the first and last are cropped.

name: Lit panel, dark row
blueprint: One dark field, 96svh tall. Across its middle runs a horizontal row of five to seven interface panels, each a different true-size fragment marked data-ui (an open menu, an inspector, a composer, a chart card), 320–460px wide at their natural heights, vertically centred and 26vw apart. The row scrolls sideways with scroll-snap-type: x mandatory and scroll-snap-align: center, and can be dragged. Only the panel at the centre is lit: full opacity, in the product's light theme, the brightest thing on screen. The others sit at 22% opacity and are inert. The viewport's edges crop the outermost panels. In the gap to the right of the centred panel, top-aligned with it, a 24ch column gives its name at 24px in a light weight and two lines at 16px in a lifted ink; this text changes as panels arrive. There is no heading above the row.
mobile: The row is 62svh tall; panels snap one per screen at true size, capped at 86vw wide, with neighbours showing 7vw at each side at 22% opacity. The name and its two lines sit beneath the row on the left margin and change with the centred panel. Swiping moves the row.

name: Giant command list
blueprint: The capabilities are set as the product's own command menu, scaled up until it is the section; the root is marked data-ui. First a real search `<input>` at clamp(28px, 3vw, 44px) across columns 1–10: a filled block one tone off the ground, 1.9em tall, whose placeholder of two to four words serves as the heading ('Find a command'). Beneath it six to eight capability names, one per line, at clamp(36px, 4.6vw, 76px), leading 1.1, flush left, each row the full content width. At the right end of a row sits its shortcut as key caps: filled squares 1em tall, one character each, in the text face. The selected row lies on a solid block of the accent colour and shows one sentence at 17px under its name. Typing filters the rows; arrow keys and hover move the selection. Nothing else is in the section.
mobile: The input is 56px tall at 20px. Capability names are set at 8.5vw, one per line; key caps are dropped, since a phone has no shortcuts. Tapping a name selects it: the accent block and the 16px sentence open beneath it and the previous one closes. Filtering still works.

name: Sentences with switches
blueprint: Four or five capabilities, each one plain sentence of five to eight words about what the product will do for you, each ending in a working switch. Every sentence is a full-bleed band 20vh tall, butted against the next with no gap. Inside, on the 12-column grid: the sentence at clamp(30px, 3.6vw, 60px) on one line in columns 1–10, vertically centred; in columns 11–12, right-aligned, the product's real toggle, built in em with its root marked data-ui, 1.1em tall so it matches the type. Off, a band is the page ground and its sentence is in the soft ink. On, the band fills with a palette colour, a different one per band, the sentence turns to full ink and a second line at 17px appears beneath stating the consequence in figures. Two bands are on at load. Toggles answer click, Space and Enter. There is no heading; the first sentence does that work.
mobile: Bands are at least 132px tall. The sentence is set at 6.4vw on two lines in the left 76% of the width; the toggle sits at the right, vertically centred, with a 44px touch target. When a band is on, the consequence line opens under the sentence at 15px.
bannedWhy: Features set as switches, the ones off greyed, a palette colour per band: the r6-p32 template; its data-ui root hides it from decorative-control (round 6 review).

name: Panel with margin notes
blueprint: One tall panel from the product is shown whole, like a plate in a manual, with notes in both margins. The panel (an inspector, a sidebar, a composer) is built at true size, 360–400px wide and 640–720px tall, root marked data-ui, and stands in columns 5–8 on the plain ground with no stage behind it. Six notes describe six of its parts: three in columns 1–4, right-aligned, and three in columns 9–12, left-aligned, each 24ch wide and placed by absolute top offsets so its first line is level with the control it explains. A note is a name at 18px medium and two lines at 15px in the soft ink. Hovering or focusing a note keeps its control at full strength and drops the rest of the panel to 30% opacity; the controls themselves also work. The heading, two to four words at 32–40px, sits right-aligned in columns 1–4, level with the panel's top edge.
mobile: The panel is shown in three slices, top, middle and bottom, each at true size and centred, cut where the next begins. Under each slice its two notes sit side by side in two columns at 15px. 56px between slices. The heading leads at 26px on the left margin.

name: Fixed output, live controls
blueprint: A split the reader operates. Left, columns 1–6: a flat colour field that is position: sticky; top: 0; height: 100svh, edge to edge, holding one thing the product makes (a card, an email, a chart, a rendered page) centred at true size, about 420px wide, root marked data-ui. Right, columns 8–12: a reading column no wider than 44ch, with four or five capability blocks 50vh apart. Each block is a sentence at 28–32px, a paragraph at 17px, and directly beneath it one real control at interface size: a slider, a segmented choice, a toggle, a short text field. Operating a control changes the fixed output on the left at once, and changes persist, so by the last block the reader has configured their own. The section heading, two to four words at 40–44px, opens the right column, 72px from the top.
mobile: The output sits in a sticky field at the top, 42svh tall, cropped to its most telling region, not shrunk. Blocks scroll beneath on the page ground: sentence at 22px, paragraph at 16px, control at full width with 44px targets. The field releases after the last block.

name: Close-ups on a board
blueprint: A board of filled tiles, each a macro view of one small part of the interface. A 12-column grid with 8px gaps, 104px rows and 10px outer margins, no empty cells, no outlines. Eight tiles in four sizes: 6×4, 6×2, 3×4 and 3×2 (columns × rows). Each tile is a flat palette colour with overflow: hidden and holds one real element, built in em and enlarged to 300–400% through the font-size of its data-ui root: a toggle, a pair of key caps, a status word on its block, one figure from a readout, a slider thumb on its track, three stacked initials discs. The element is pushed off-centre so two of the tile's edges crop it. Bottom-left in every tile, 20px in: the capability's name at 18px medium and one line at 15px. One 6×2 tile holds only the heading, two to four words at clamp(36px, 4vw, 60px), top-left.
mobile: Two columns, 6px gaps, rows of 28vw. Large tiles span both columns and three rows; the rest are one column by two rows. The heading tile leads at full width, two rows tall, type at 9vw. Enlarged elements keep their scale and are cropped harder; captions stay bottom-left at 16px and 14px.
bannedWhy: A board of filled tiles of interface close-ups (a bento).

name: One card, four fields
blueprint: Four flat colour fields stand side by side across the full viewport, each 25vw wide and 84svh tall, butted together with no gaps; neighbours differ clearly in lightness. The same card from the product (a ticket, an order, a request) appears once in each field at the same height, 38% down, centred, 260px wide at true size, each copy marked data-ui. It is further along every time: bare as it arrives, then with an owner and a due date, then with its checklist half ticked, then closed with its final figure. Along the bottom of each field, 28px in, one clause at clamp(22px, 2vw, 32px) on two lines begins with its order word: 'First it lands here.' 'Then someone takes it.' The heading, two to four words at the same size in the heaviest weight, sits top-left in the first field only. On hover a field's card rises 6px over 150ms.
mobile: The fields stack, each full width and 64svh tall, colours meeting edge to edge. In each: the clause at 24px top-left with 20px margins, then the card at true size, left-aligned, 32px below. The heading sits in the first field above its clause, at 24px in the heaviest weight.

name: Call and response column
blueprint: The sequence is shown as what you give and what comes back, in one narrow column 560px wide starting at column 4, or on the page's text axis. Three exchanges, 88px apart. Each opens with a sentence at 20px medium that begins with its order word ('First, install it.' 'Then ask for a chart.'). 16px under it, the call: the literal thing the user enters, in a filled panel one tone off the ground, radius 8px, padding 20px. For a developer tool that is real code in `<pre><code>` at 14px with a working copy button; otherwise it is the product's own input holding real typed text. Under the call, indented 56px, the response: a true-size fragment marked data-ui showing what the product returns. The third response is the finished result and breaks out of the column, 760px wide, running to column 12. The heading, two to four words at 28px, sits 56px above the first sentence.
mobile: The column fills the width with 20px margins. Calls and responses stack without the indent; a 24px gap and a lighter panel tone set the response apart. Code panels scroll sideways inside themselves. The final result runs edge to edge at true size, cropped on the right if wider.

name: Drag through the stages
blueprint: A 50/50 split, 88svh tall: two flat fields meeting on a clean vertical edge, and one slider that drives both. Left field: the current stage as a clause of three to six words at clamp(40px, 4.6vw, 76px) on two lines, top-left from column 1, starting with its order word; it serves as the heading. Right field: one fragment of the product at true size, about 440px wide, centred, root marked data-ui, in the state that matches the clause. Along the bottom, crossing both fields inside 28px margins, a real range `<input>` with four stops: a solid track 8px tall, the part already passed in full ink, and a square thumb 32px across in the accent. Under the track, four stage names at 16px, the current one in full ink. Dragging, or the arrow keys, swaps the clause and the fragment's state with a 200ms crossfade; nothing depends on scroll.
mobile: The fragment's field comes first, 46svh, the fragment at true size and cropped to its active region. The slider follows directly beneath on the seam, thumb 40px. Then the clause field: the clause at 9vw on two lines, with the four stage names under it in a two-by-two block at 15px.

name: Stages as one bar
blueprint: The product's progress bar, enlarged until it spans the page, is the diagram. One bar runs across columns 1–12, 22vh tall, built as a flex row of three or four solid segments with 6px gaps, root marked data-ui. Each segment's width follows how long that stage really takes (flex-grow from the true durations, 12% minimum), and each is a different flat palette colour, so the reader sees at once that signing up is a sliver and the rest is the product working. Inside every segment, top-left with 20px padding, its duration in words at clamp(20px, 2vw, 30px): 'Two minutes', 'About a day'. Under each segment, on its left edge, one clause at 17px, 22ch wide, beginning with its order word. Above the bar, 64px clear of it, the heading: two to five words at clamp(48px, 6.4vw, 104px), flush left. Nothing else.
mobile: The bar turns vertical: segments stack as full-width blocks whose heights keep the proportions, 72px minimum, 6px gaps, about 70svh in total. Each holds its duration at 22px top-left and its clause at 16px beneath. The heading sits above at 11vw on two lines.

name: Figure set by a slider
blueprint: The number is the visitor's own. A flat field at least 88svh tall. Top-left, on the page margin: a question of two to five words at 36–44px that serves as the heading ('How many invoices a month?'). 28px under it, one control from the product at true size, 400px wide, root marked data-ui: a slider with its real label and current value, or a stepper, or a short numeric field, preset to a typical answer. Then a long gap. Bottom-left, on the same edge, the result at clamp(140px, 19vw, 320px), heavy, leading 0.8, tabular numerals, with its unit at 0.22em on the same baseline. It recalculates on every input event from a stated, honest formula. Bottom-right, on the figure's baseline, one sentence at 17px, 30ch wide, says how the figure is worked out. No other figure appears in the section.
mobile: Question at 26px, then the control at full width with a 44px thumb. The figure sits at the bottom at 30vw with its unit beneath it at 20px, both flush left. The working-out sentence follows at 15px. The section is at least 84svh so the gap between control and figure survives.

name: Bars standing on the edge
blueprint: The product's own chart, drawn in HTML, is the whole section. A full-bleed field 90svh tall. Along its bottom edge stand ten to fourteen solid bars, one per true value (months, releases, cohorts), in a CSS grid spanning the full viewport width with 8px gaps and no side margins; heights are the values scaled so the tallest is 58vh. No axes, no grid, no legend; the chart's root is marked data-ui. Every bar is one tone two steps from the field except the one the page is about, which takes the accent. Three bars print their value directly above themselves at clamp(20px, 2vw, 30px), tabular. The headline figure sits top-left on the page margin at clamp(88px, 10vw, 168px), and its claim, two to five words at 28px, sits beneath it on the same margin. Hovering or focusing a bar shows its value and period above it.
mobile: Bars run sideways: each a full-width row 28px tall growing from the left edge, 6px gaps, eight values at most. The headline figure sits above at 26vw with its claim at 22px. Three rows print their value at 17px inside the bar's right end. The accent row stays.

name: Quote as comment thread
blueprint: The customer's words arrive the way words arrive inside the product: as a comment. One comment component from the interface is built in em, its root marked data-ui, and enlarged through the root's font-size until the body text is clamp(28px, 3vw, 46px), leading 1.2. It occupies columns 2–9 on the plain ground. It keeps every real part: a filled disc with the speaker's initials, name and company on one line at 0.5em, a true date, the quotation as the comment body (no quotation marks; the component already says who is speaking) and the product's own small resolved or reaction state beneath. Below it, indented to the body text's left edge, two shorter quotations follow as replies in the same component at true size, 440px wide, 32px apart. Columns 10–12 stay empty. There is no heading; the first comment is the largest type in the section.
mobile: The large comment fills the width inside 20px margins, body text at 7vw, initials disc 40px. The two replies follow at true size, indented 28px, using the remaining width, 24px apart. Dates and states stay. Nothing is centred.

name: First step, already open
blueprint: The page ends with the product's first screen already open. A full-bleed field in the accent colour, 90svh tall. Right, in columns 7–11, vertically centred: the product's own create dialog at true size, 440px wide, root marked data-ui, with its real title ('Name your workspace'), one text field holding an editable, believable example, one two-option segmented choice and its primary button. Inside the fragment the product's conventions apply, including the shadow its dialog normally casts. The field accepts typing, the choice switches, and the primary button is the page's only action: it carries the typed value into sign-up. Left, in columns 1–5, anchored to the bottom with 40px margins: the closing line, two to four words at clamp(56px, 7vw, 112px), leading 0.92, on two lines, and under it one sentence at 17px saying what happens after the button. The upper-left stays empty.
mobile: The closing line leads at 13vw on two lines, top-left, with its sentence beneath at 16px. The dialog follows at full width inside 16px margins, at true size, its primary button 52px tall and full width. The field is at least 84svh; the dialog sits in its lower half.

name: Names passing a held square
blueprint: A flat ground and one centred column of very large names: eight to fourteen project or product names in condensed capitals at clamp(96px, 14vw, 200px), leading 0.85, one per line and each line centred, so long names run nearly to the margins and short ones leave wide ground either side. A square frame 450px across (31vw), square corners, holds at the centre of the viewport behind the list: a sticky element (`position: sticky; top: calc(50svh - 225px)`) at the head of the list with a negative bottom margin equal to its height, centred, below the names in the stacking order, so the passing names cross the picture and are never hidden by it. Choose pictures with a calm centre, or lay a flat dark scrim at 40% inside the frame, so the crossing name keeps 3:1. In the study the picture sits on top of the names; here nothing lies on top of large type. It shows the picture of whichever name is crossing its centre (an IntersectionObserver with a thin root margin at the viewport's middle sets the current name) and swaps with a 200ms crossfade. Level with the frame's middle, 48px to its left and right, two facts about the current item sit at 16px, the kind of work on the left and the year or price on the right, changing with it. The heading opens the list as its first line, at the same size in the soft ink, two words at most. Every name is a link. The section runs about three screens, so each name holds the centre for about a quarter of a screen.
mobile: Names drop to 15vw and may wrap to two lines, still centred. The frame shrinks to a 60vw square and stays sticky at the centre; the two facts move into one row at 16px directly under it. The heading line stays first.

name: Title torn at the seam
blueprint: A wrapper about 95svh tall per project holds a sticky stage of 100svh, split at exactly 50vw into two portrait panes of 720×900px, `object-fit: cover`, square corners, no gap: two different pictures or loops of the same project (the whole and a detail, before and after). The project's title sits on the seam, centred on x 720 at the optical middle: capitals in a heavy face at clamp(96px, 11vw, 160px), leading 0.8, tracking -0.04em, at most two lines, in one light colour chosen per project. It is set twice inside the one heading element, the second copy `aria-hidden`, each copy clipped to its own half with `clip-path: inset(0 50% 0 0)` and `inset(0 0 0 50%)`. Directly under it, centred, the discipline and year at 16px and a text link with an arrow at 16px. While a project crosses the stage, the left pane and left half-title travel up and the right pane and right half-title travel down (panes ±20svh, title ±30svh, on a scroll-linked timeline), so the name tears at the seam and lines up exactly when the project is centred. The section's two-word heading sits at clamp(28px, 2.4vw, 36px) in the stage's top-left corner, 32px in. Four to eight projects; the stage releases after the last. Under reduced motion the halves stay aligned and the projects change by crossfade.
mobile: Keep the split: two strips 195px wide running the full height of the screen with the same opposing travel. The title drops to 12.5vw on the seam, at most two lines, with the discipline line and the link under it at 16px; give the link a 44px hit area.

name: One slide, two neighbours
blueprint: Each project is one band the full width of the viewport. In its middle stands one slide 73% of the width (1046×600px, x 197–1243), square corners, `object-fit: cover`. The previous and next pictures of the same project peek in at the edges, 177px of each visible, with 20px gaps, so the row reads as a filmstrip cut by the viewport. The strip scrolls sideways with `overflow-x: auto` and `scroll-snap-type: x mandatory`, each picture snapping to the centre, the scrollbar hidden. 26px under the strip runs one row at 16px on the 12-column grid with 20px margins, every item on a fixed column start: the project's name in the full ink at column 1 with its category in the soft ink after it, the recognition it received at column 4, the year at column 7, the team or client at column 10. A text link with an arrow sits 24px under the name. 240px of ground separates one project from the next, and all projects share one photographic treatment so the run reads as a set. The section's heading, two or three words at clamp(40px, 4vw, 60px), sits on the left margin 96px above the first strip.
mobile: The slide is 78% of the width at 4:5, with 32px of each neighbour showing and 10px gaps, still snapping. The row of facts becomes two columns, name and category on the left, year and team from 50% of the width; the link drops under the name. 64px between projects.

name: Cards crossing a held photograph
blueprint: A wrapper about 350svh tall holds a sticky stage of 100svh. On the stage one full-bleed photograph of the subject's ground (a landscape, a material, an aerial texture) stays still, darkened evenly with `filter: brightness(0.6)`. Over it a track of four to six cards travels from right to left as the page scrolls (a `translateX` tied to the wrapper's scroll progress), so one card is always near the centre and the next shows about 300px at the right edge. Each card is 720×560px, square corners, vertically centred with 170px of photograph above and below it: its top 68% is a photograph of one item (a room, a building, a stop on the route), its lower 32% a flat panel in one earth tone from the palette, a different tone per card at a similar lightness, holding the item's name at clamp(32px, 3vw, 48px) bottom-left with 28px padding and a two-line description at 16px right-aligned beside it. Cards are 40px apart. The section heading, two to four words at clamp(40px, 4.4vw, 68px) in the paper colour, sits top-left on the stage over the photograph before the first card arrives and moves out ahead of it. Keep the run under three screens; at its end the stage releases into the next section.
mobile: No pin and no sideways travel. The photograph runs full-bleed as a 4:5 band under the heading at 9vw, and the cards follow it at full width minus 16px margins, 24px apart, each a 4:3 photograph over its colour panel 140px tall, with the name at 26px and the description at 16px.
bannedWhy: Cards travelling over a darkened full-bleed photograph, each in its own tone: cards laid on a picture and colour sprawl (round 11).

name: Object riding down the schedule
blueprint: A schedule of dated events (races, concerts, tastings, departures) with the subject's own object travelling down it. On a dark flat ground, on the page's own margins, the heading is one centred line of condensed capitals at clamp(40px, 3.6vw, 56px), split into its two words with a gap between them, and in the gap stands a cut-out photograph of the object seen from above or in profile, about 320px wide (22% of the width) and up to 64% of the viewport tall. Below come full-width rows 84px tall, each a two-part grid: the event's name at 26px in condensed capitals on the left with a one-line note at 16px in the soft ink under it, and the date and place right-aligned at 16px on the note's baseline. Rows alternate between the ground and a tone one step lighter instead of rules. As the page scrolls, the object leaves the heading and moves down the centre line over the rows (`position: sticky` in a centred column that spans the list, `pointer-events: none`), where it covers only the empty middle of each row and marks how far the reader has come. The row for the next event takes the accent colour across its whole band, with its name and date in the accent's ink. About ten rows fit on one screen; the list ends 120px under the last row.
mobile: Rows stack at full width on 20px margins: the name at 22px on up to two lines, the note at 16px, the date under the note. The object shrinks to 40% of the width and stays in the heading; it does not travel, because on a phone it would cover the rows. The accent band stays on the next event.

name: Rising triptych
blueprint: A wrapper about 200svh tall holds a sticky stage of 100svh on the plain page ground. The heading, two lines at clamp(32px, 2.8vw, 44px), is centred in the top fifth of the stage with one sentence at 17px under it. From the bottom edge three photographs rise as the page scrolls, each at its own speed. The centre one, a 4:5 portrait, starts 620px wide with only its top quarter showing and grows (scale and travel on a scroll-linked timeline) until it is about 760px wide with its top 40px below the sentence, cropped by the bottom edge, so it never reaches the heading. In the study it slides over the heading; here nothing lies on top of a heading. The two outer ones, each 360×530px, stand beside it with 10px gaps, their tops always 55px lower than the centre's, and by the end they are cut by the left and right viewport edges. Square corners, no captions, one consistent light across all three (warm interiors with warm, cold coast with cold). Under reduced motion show the end state with the heading above the three photographs.
mobile: The centre portrait starts at 60% of the width and grows to nearly the full height; the outer two show as 40px slivers at the screen edges. The heading and sentence sit in the top third above it.

name: Portrait on its own ground
blueprint: One chapter per screen, three to six chapters. Each is a full-bleed field 100svh tall whose flat colour is taken from its own photograph: the darkest large tone in the picture (a deep brown for a wooden interior, a slate for a winter coast), so picture and page seem to be one surface. In the centre stands one portrait photograph at 3:4, 506×675px (75% of the height), top 112px, square corners, no frame. Type sits in the corners on 32px margins in the light ink: the chapter's title at clamp(28px, 2.4vw, 36px) top-left as its heading; one sentence at 17px, max 32ch, bottom-left; a text link to the chapter's page bottom-right. As each chapter arrives its field starts as a panel inset 20px from the viewport edges and grows to full-bleed, while the portrait scales from 0.92 to 1 (background colour over 600ms, scale over 800ms, both easing out), so the change reads as the room changing, not as a new slide. A chapter may hold a short muted loop or a single enlarged letterform in place of the portrait, on the same kind of field. The first chapter's title doubles as the section heading.
mobile: The portrait becomes 80% of the width at 3:4, centred at 45% of the height. The title sits top-left at 24px, and the sentence and link stack bottom-left at 16px under the portrait. The field still takes the picture's darkest tone.

name: Question at both edges
blueprint: For a closing choice between two answers: book or ask, this date or that, the tasting or the tour. A flat field exactly 100svh tall in the darkest tone. The question is a two-line heading at clamp(110px, 11vw, 168px), leading 1.0, centred, about 54% of the width: line one with its cap line 32px under the field's top edge, line two with its baseline 24px above the bottom edge. The band of about 560px between them is empty except for one row at its optical centre: two solid rectangular buttons, each about 200×56px with its label at 18px in medium weight, their inner edges 120px either side of the centre axis, and between them, exactly on the axis, the word 'or' at 18px in the soft ink. 16px under the row, centred, one line at 16px in the soft ink says what happens after either choice. The type above and below closes the empty band, so it reads as held breath rather than a gap.
mobile: The question drops to 18vw, still two centred lines, line one 32px from the top and line two 24px above the bottom. The buttons stack at the centre at 72% of the width, 12px apart, with 'or' between them and the line of explanation under the second.

name: Headline crossing onto a photograph
blueprint: A white or pale ground. A photograph taller than it is wide, 720px wide (columns 7–12), ends on the right page margin with its top at 46% of the section's first screen and runs below the fold. The heading starts on the 32px left margin across columns 1–8: two lines of light-weight serif capitals at clamp(64px, 5.6vw, 88px), leading 1.04, the first line starting 34% down the screen and the second placed so that its right half runs onto the photograph's upper-left corner. Choose a picture whose upper-left quarter is pale enough for the ink, or set the second line twice, in the ink and in the paper colour, each copy clipped to its side of the photograph's left edge. Under the heading on columns 1–5, one paragraph of up to 25 words at 22px, leading 1.4. At the bottom-left a second, smaller photograph of 360×400px enters, cropped by the screen's lower edge, and on the next screen becomes the left half of a staggered pair with the large one. Nothing else is on the screen.
mobile: The heading sits at 10vw on two lines on the 20px margin. The photograph becomes 75% of the content width, ending on the right margin, and starts under the heading's first line so the second line crosses its top-left corner. The paragraph follows at 17px, then the small photograph at 50% of the width on the left margin.

name: Four cards dealt into a fan
blueprint: Four values, rules or features, each on a card dealt onto the table as the page scrolls. A wrapper about 400svh tall holds a sticky stage of 100svh on the page's darkest flat ground. Each card is a portrait panel of 340×400px with a 20px radius, filled with its own palette colour (four colours that differ clearly in lightness), no border, no shadow. On a card, with 28px padding: its name at 32px in heavy capitals on one or two lines at the top, a photograph or a single picture of the thing at 60% of the card's width in the middle, and one sentence at 16px at the foot. Card one lands alone at the centre; each further quarter of the wrapper deals the next from below the bottom edge, landing 250px to the right of the one before, rotated between -4 and 4 degrees and overlapping only its right 90px, until the four form a fan about 1,090px wide centred on the stage. Keep each card's name, picture and sentence inside its left 240px, so no card ever covers another's words. In the study the cards overlap by two thirds and bury the earlier titles; here nothing lies on top of text. The heading, two to four words at clamp(40px, 4vw, 60px), sits top-left on the stage on the 32px margin with one sentence at 17px under it. The stage releases after the fourth card has settled; under reduced motion the fan is simply there.
mobile: No pin. The cards sit in one row that scrolls sideways with scroll-snap, each 82% of the width with the next peeking in at the right edge, all upright. The heading and sentence sit above the row.

name: Small index, large picture
blueprint: A sticky stage of 100svh split 38/62. The right part, from x 560 to the right page margin, is one photograph the full height of the stage, cut by its top and bottom, with the dealt corner: a staged picture of the current project in use, in a real place. The left column, from the 20px margin to x 520, holds the heading at the top, two lines at clamp(80px, 8.2vw, 120px), leading 0.95, 40px under the navigation; then empty ground; then, anchored to the bottom with a 32px margin, the index: three to six rows 44px tall, each with the project's name at 28px on the left and two or three disciplines at 16px right-aligned in the soft ink. The current row is in the full ink and the others in the soft ink; rows are told apart by space only. Each project gets one viewport of scroll: as it arrives, its photograph wipes in from the bottom edge (`clip-path: inset(100% 0 0 0)` to `inset(0)` over 900ms) and the current row moves down the list. The empty middle of the left column is closed by the heading above it and the index below.
mobile: The heading sits at the top at 14vw on two lines, then the photograph at full width at 4:5, sticky under the heading while the index rows below it change the picture; or let each project simply stack as photograph and row.

name: Cards that fold into spines
blueprint: For a journal, a run of notes or a list of chapters without pictures. A wrapper about 400svh tall holds a sticky stage of 100svh. The heading, two to four words at clamp(48px, 4.2vw, 64px), sits top-left on the 32px margin, 120px from the top. Under it a band 360px tall spans the content width and holds a horizontal deck of text cards, each about 620px wide, in three neighbouring flat tones of one hue taken in turn. On a card, with 32px padding: its title at 30px on up to two lines, leading 1.1; an excerpt of two lines at 16px; and along the bottom edge the date on the left and a text link to read it on the right, both at 16px. As the page scrolls, each step slides the next card in from the right edge and squeezes the earlier ones into slivers 120px wide stacked edge to edge at the left, like book spines, where only the first letters of their titles show, clipped by the sliver. Clicking a sliver brings its card back. 48px under the band, the number of entries and a link to the full list sit at 17px on the left margin, so the stage does not end on an empty floor.
mobile: No pin and no slivers. The cards stack at full width with 12px gaps, each in its tone, the title at 24px, the excerpt at 16px, the date and link at the foot. The heading sits above them at 10vw.

name: Photographs gathered round a heading
blueprint: A band about one screen tall on the plain page ground, used as the page's one deliberate rest. At its visual centre sits the heading, two lines at clamp(32px, 2.6vw, 40px) in a light weight, centred, with one sentence at 17px under it and a text link beneath that. Around it six to eight small photographs are scattered irregularly across the middle columns (x 320–1120; the outer 320px on each side stay empty, equally), each 160–200px wide at about 9:10, square corners, at different heights with 60–200px of air between them. Two of them come within 40px of the heading's block, which their drift never reaches, so the cluster reads as gathered round it rather than laid on a grid. No captions and no frames. Each photograph drifts at its own rate as the band passes (4–12% of its own height on a scroll-linked timeline), so the cluster loosens and tightens; under reduced motion it stays put. The pictures come from one place or one day and share one treatment.
mobile: Five photographs at 30% of the width sit offset left and right around the centred heading, two above it and three below, none cut by an edge. The heading drops to 7vw on two lines.
